findings.title: The concurrent reader thread is never joined before asserting failures
findings.body: The test sets `deletedAll` and immediately asserts that `caughtExceptions` is empty, but the reader may already be executing a request (or enter its catch block) when the assertion runs. An exception from that in-flight request can therefore be added after the assertion, allowing the test to pass despite the regression. The unjoined thread can also continue running into subsequent test/realm cleanup. Keep the thread reference and join it after signalling termination (with a timeout), then assert its completion and collected exceptions.
